dict.string: Atlas uses the camera to scan food barcodes, take a profile photo (stored locally), and photograph meals, food packages and tables for nutrition estimation. Meal, package and table photos are sent securely to Anthropic's Claude, through Atlas's server, for analysis; Atlas's server does not store them. Barcode scans and profile photos stay on your device.
Atlas uses Face ID to optionally lock the app, so your protocols and health data stay private if your device is unlocked. Face ID is optional — you can disable it in Settings.

Atlas reads HRV, resting heart rate, VO2 max, sleep, steps, and workouts your Apple Watch or other apps record (with their distance, active energy and heart rate) from Apple Health, plus weight if you turn on workout, weight and water sync, to show recovery trends, list those workouts in your training history, estimate your Biological Age, and correlate them with what you log. Once you log body fat, waist, blood pressure or body temperature on the Biology tab, it also reads that measurement to chart it there. Analysis happens on your device; if you enable the optional AI weekly summary, weekly averages of HRV, resting heart rate, and sleep hours are sent securely to Anthropic's Claude, through Atlas's server, to write your recap, and if you allow Ask Atlas on the Biology tab, a summary of your Biological Age and the readings behind it is sent the same way to answer your questions; Atlas's server does not store them.

Atlas only writes to Apple Health when you turn a setting on. With "Sync workouts, weight and water" on, it saves finished workouts, weigh-ins and water you log. With "Write meals to Apple Health" on, it saves the calories, protein, carbohydrates and fat from meals you log. Both settings are off until you enable them. When you log body fat, waist, blood pressure or body temperature on the Biology tab, Atlas saves that reading to Apple Health.
Atlas reads your phone's tilt only while a meal table is in play, so the plates roll the way you tilt. Motion data never leaves the screen.
Atlas saves share images and videos to your Photo Library only when you choose Save to Photos, and saves a table photo only when you turn on Save original. Atlas does not read your Photo Library.
